    About Me

    I am Carole Périgois, a scientist driven by curiosity, creativity, and the ambition to bridge rigorous research with real-world impact. My background in high-energy physics and astrophysics has led me to work on some of the most fascinating questions in modern science: black holes, gravitational waves, and the statistical modeling of complex data. Beyond the lab, I am passionate about collaborative work, mentoring, and applying data science and AI to societal and environmental challenges.

    I thrive in interdisciplinary environments where innovation meets concrete applications, and I value strong teamwork, leadership, and open communication as the foundation for successful projects.

    🎓 Education & Research Background

    • Postdoctoral Researcher – University of Padua, Italy (2021–2025)
      Focus: gravitational waves phenomenology, data analysis, and simulations of astrophysical populations.

    • Ph.D. in High-Energy Physics – Université Savoie Mont-Blanc, France (2018–2021)
      Thesis on black hole mergers, gravitational wave data analysis, and statistical inference.

    • Master in Subatomic Physics (Research Track) – Université de Nantes, France

    • National Qualification as Maître de Conférences (Associate Professor, 2022–2027, France)

    🛠️ Skills & Expertise

    Scientific & Technical

    • Data analysis: statistical inference, Bayesian and frequentist methods
    • Signal processing: time/frequency analysis, noise modeling
    • Machine learning: classification, regression, convolutional neural networks
    • Simulation and modeling: astrophysical populations, noise propagation
    • Software development: modular pipelines, documentation (Sphinx), open-source tools

    Programming

    • Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, …)
    • Git (version control & collaborative development)
    • Matlab / Simulink
    • C++ / C#

    Project Leadership & Collaboration

    • Leading international research projects
    • Team building and mentoring (Ph.D. students, postdocs, workshops)
    • Scientific communication (seminars, publications, conferences)
    • Interdisciplinary collaborations and agile teamwork

    Languages

    • English (fluent)
    • Italian (basic)
    • French (native)

    🌟 Values & Soft Skills

    • Scientific rigor with a strong analytical mindset
    • Curiosity & creativity in exploring new research directions
    • Team spirit & leadership, fostering collaboration and mentoring
    • Pedagogy & outreach, from university teaching to public science communication
    • Commitment & responsibility, both in academic and associative contexts

    🚀 Beyond Research

    Outside of academia, I actively engage in associative projects and independent studies, applying my skills to data-driven solutions with humanitarian and environmental purposes.
    Recent examples include:

    • Developing AI-based methods for environmental monitoring using satellite data.
    • Designing open-source tools for scientific reproducibility and robust data pipelines.
